material_decisions.facts: RPC assigns pending method by actual generated id, creates account context only on matched response and captures decoded receive UTC/monotonic/sequence/server PID before event/accounting. call passes actual completion object by identity. Request log/heartbeat/mtime never creates success.

material_decisions.clause: durable same cumulative credit/state before success
material_decisions.facts: Full original accounting first persists existing CreditBudget.observe and matching state. New PENDING observation dominates older receipt. Saved disk limits/ledger/state credit equality checked before trial validation and final accepted receipt save. Ledger.id/guard.identifier and original budget remain exact; no reset/allowance/refund.

Newest actual (monotonic receive,sequence) across read/notification metadata must be ACCEPTED. Newer pending/rejected item vetoes older success. Newer response error is saved REJECTED. Unknown/spend/account/stop/exhausted effects still traverse original accounting and stop paths. Both UTC and monotonic ages must be nonnegative and strictly below25s.

Actual old read remains conservatively accounted through same original ledger. Actual newer limits are restored and re-observed without changing receive clocks; existing genuine stop/error is not cleared. Down/up/down may count conservatively as expressly defined by unchanged CreditBudget.observe, never refund.

Original exception tail and memory same-RPC notification marker semantics unchanged. New poll receipt never populates that marker. Notification fallback can keep existing controller path alive; the new pure consumer validator conservatively refuses an intervening newer REJECTED read.

Receipt binds actual boot, repo/logdir/thread/guardian/goal hash, worker/server PID+birth, original credit run/budget/path and complete limits+ledger hashes. Actual current owner and live kernel checks belong to independently pinned consumer/admission; receipt never creates owner/native/account authority. Constructor discards inherited receipt fields before current start.

required_before_production: Root integrates exact reviewed bytes through legitimate normal same-Root transition, binds actual loaded interpreter/source and independently current owner/goal/boot/credit context, corrects consumer liveness and reviews actual future operation/admission. No hotpatch/competing controller/new credit run/synthetic observation.
review_method: Read actual frozen source/callers/credit semantics and compare nonlocation AST; parse saved actual outputs only. No candidate import, execution, account query or production-state access by reviewer.
separate_consumer_finding: CONSUMER-LIVE-01 in combined review: Root43935 kernel birth checks omit terminal process state. This does not alter the SDK39a source verdict.
